keyPoints.en: The digestive system = digestive tract (mouth to anus) + accessory organs (salivary glands, liver, gall bladder, pancreas).
keyPoints.bm: Sistem pencernaan = salur pencernaan (mulut hingga dubur) + organ aksesori (kelenjar liur, hati, pundi hempedu, pankreas).

keyPoints.en: Food passes: mouth → oesophagus → stomach → duodenum → ileum → large intestine → rectum → anus.
keyPoints.bm: Makanan melalui: mulut → esofagus → perut → duodenum → ileum → usus besar → rektum → dubur.

keyPoints.en: Peristalsis — waves of muscle contraction — pushes food along.
keyPoints.bm: Peristalsis — gelombang pengecutan otot — menolak makanan sepanjang salur.

keyPoints.en: Stages of nutrition: ingestion → digestion → absorption → assimilation → defecation.
keyPoints.bm: Peringkat nutrisi: ingesti → pencernaan → penyerapan → asimilasi → penyahtinjaan.

question.en: Name the organ that produces bile and the organ that stores it.
question.bm: Namakan organ yang menghasilkan hempedu dan organ yang menyimpannya.

answer.en: Liver produces it; gall bladder stores it.

tip.en: Practise labelling a diagram of the digestive system — it's in almost every exam.
tip.bm: Berlatih melabel rajah sistem pencernaan — ia ada dalam hampir setiap peperiksaan.

keyPoints.en: Physical digestion: chewing, churning in the stomach, emulsification by bile.
keyPoints.bm: Pencernaan fizikal: mengunyah, mengisar dalam perut, pengemulsian oleh hempedu.

keyPoints.en: Mouth: salivary amylase — starch → maltose.
keyPoints.bm: Mulut: amilase liur — kanji → maltosa.

keyPoints.en: Stomach: HCl (pH 2) kills bacteria; pepsin — protein → polypeptides; rennin coagulates milk protein.
keyPoints.bm: Perut: HCl (pH 2) membunuh bakteria; pepsin — protein → polipeptida; renin mengentalkan protein susu.

keyPoints.en: Duodenum: bile emulsifies fat; pancreatic amylase, trypsin and lipase work at pH ~8.
keyPoints.bm: Duodenum: hempedu mengemulsikan lemak; amilase pankreas, tripsin dan lipase bertindak pada pH ~8.

keyPoints.en: Ileum: maltase, sucrase, lactase, erepsin, lipase finish digestion → glucose, amino acids, fatty acids, glycerol.
keyPoints.bm: Ileum: maltase, sukrase, laktase, erepsin, lipase melengkapkan pencernaan → glukosa, asid amino, asid lemak, gliserol.

question.en: Why do people without a gall bladder find fatty food harder to digest?
question.bm: Mengapa orang tanpa pundi hempedu sukar mencerna makanan berlemak?

answer.en: Less bile is released at once, so fats are not emulsified well and lipase works slowly.
answer.bm: Kurang hempedu dibebaskan sekaligus, jadi lemak tidak teremulsi dengan baik dan lipase bertindak perlahan.

tip.en: Make a table: site → juice → enzyme → substrate → product → pH.
tip.bm: Buat jadual: tempat → jus → enzim → substrat → hasil → pH.

keyPoints.en: Absorption happens mainly in the ileum, through millions of villi.
keyPoints.bm: Penyerapan berlaku terutamanya di ileum, melalui berjuta-juta vilus.

keyPoints.en: Villus adaptations: microvilli (huge surface area), one-cell-thick epithelium, dense capillaries, a lacteal.
keyPoints.bm: Penyesuaian vilus: mikrovilus (luas permukaan sangat besar), epitelium setebal satu sel, kapilari padat, lakteal.

keyPoints.en: Glucose and amino acids → blood capillaries (by diffusion and active transport) → hepatic portal vein → liver.
keyPoints.bm: Glukosa dan asid amino → kapilari darah (resapan dan pengangkutan aktif) → vena portal hepar → hati.

keyPoints.en: Fatty acids and glycerol → lacteal → lymphatic system → blood. Water and vitamins are also absorbed.
keyPoints.bm: Asid lemak dan gliserol → lakteal → sistem limfa → darah. Air dan vitamin juga diserap.

question.en: Why is the ileum very long and folded?
question.bm: Mengapa ileum sangat panjang dan berlipat?

answer.en: To give a large surface area and more time for absorption.
answer.bm: Untuk memberi luas permukaan yang besar dan lebih masa untuk penyerapan.

tip.en: Fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K) go with the fats into the lacteal.
tip.bm: Vitamin larut lemak (A, D, E, K) bersama lemak memasuki lakteal.

keyPoints.en: Assimilation: absorbed nutrients are used by cells to build structures or release energy.
keyPoints.bm: Asimilasi: nutrien yang diserap digunakan sel untuk membina struktur atau membebaskan tenaga.

keyPoints.en: Liver: excess glucose → glycogen (insulin); amino acids → plasma proteins; excess amino acids deaminated → urea.
keyPoints.bm: Hati: glukosa berlebihan → glikogen (insulin); asid amino → protein plasma; asid amino berlebihan dideaminasi → urea.

keyPoints.en: Cells: glucose for respiration; amino acids to build enzymes, hormones, new cells.
keyPoints.bm: Sel: glukosa untuk respirasi; asid amino untuk membina enzim, hormon, sel baharu.

keyPoints.en: Lipids: form plasma membranes, hormones; excess stored under the skin and around organs.
keyPoints.bm: Lipid: membentuk membran plasma, hormon; lebihan disimpan di bawah kulit dan sekeliling organ.

question.en: Where does the energy for muscle contraction come from after a meal?
question.bm: Dari manakah tenaga untuk pengecutan otot selepas makan?

answer.en: Glucose absorbed from food is used in cellular respiration in muscle cells.
answer.bm: Glukosa yang diserap daripada makanan digunakan dalam respirasi sel di sel otot.

tip.en: The liver is the 'processing factory' between absorption and the rest of the body.
tip.bm: Hati ialah 'kilang pemprosesan' antara penyerapan dan seluruh badan.

keyPoints.en: Undigested food (mainly fibre), dead cells, bacteria and bile pigments enter the large intestine.
keyPoints.bm: Makanan tidak tercerna (terutamanya serat), sel mati, bakteria dan pigmen hempedu memasuki usus besar.

keyPoints.en: The colon reabsorbs water and some vitamins (made by gut bacteria), forming semi-solid faeces.
keyPoints.bm: Kolon menyerap semula air dan sesetengah vitamin (dihasilkan bakteria usus), membentuk tinja separa pepejal.

keyPoints.en: Faeces are stored in the rectum and removed through the anus — defecation.
keyPoints.bm: Tinja disimpan dalam rektum dan disingkirkan melalui dubur — penyahtinjaan.

keyPoints.en: Fibre and water prevent constipation; too little time in the colon causes diarrhoea.
keyPoints.bm: Serat dan air mencegah sembelit; terlalu sedikit masa dalam kolon menyebabkan cirit-birit.

question.en: Why is defecation not called excretion?

answer.en: Faeces are mostly undigested food that never entered body cells, not waste made by metabolism.
answer.bm: Tinja kebanyakannya makanan tidak tercerna yang tidak pernah memasuki sel badan, bukan bahan buangan metabolisme.

tip.en: Eat fruit, vegetables and wholegrains daily for fibre.
tip.bm: Makan buah, sayur dan bijirin penuh setiap hari untuk serat.

keyPoints.en: Balanced diet: carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, fibre and water in the right proportions.
keyPoints.bm: Gizi seimbang: karbohidrat, protein, lemak, vitamin, mineral, serat dan air dalam kadar yang betul.

keyPoints.en: Needs depend on age, gender, body size, activity, health and climate (Malaysian Food Pyramid / 'Suku-Suku Separuh').
keyPoints.bm: Keperluan bergantung pada umur, jantina, saiz badan, aktiviti, kesihatan dan iklim (Piramid Makanan Malaysia / 'Suku-Suku Separuh').

keyPoints.en: Energy value of food is measured in kJ using a food calorimeter.
keyPoints.bm: Nilai tenaga makanan diukur dalam kJ menggunakan kalorimeter makanan.

keyPoints.en: Deficiencies: vitamin C → scurvy; iron → anaemia; iodine → goitre; vitamin D/calcium → rickets; protein → kwashiorkor.
keyPoints.bm: Kekurangan: vitamin C → skurvi; ferum → anemia; iodin → goiter; vitamin D/kalsium → riket; protein → kwasyiorkor.

question.en: Why does a construction worker need more energy than an office clerk?
question.bm: Mengapa pekerja binaan memerlukan lebih tenaga daripada kerani pejabat?

answer.en: Heavy physical work uses more energy, so the daily energy requirement is higher.
answer.bm: Kerja fizikal berat menggunakan lebih tenaga, jadi keperluan tenaga harian lebih tinggi.

tip.en: 'Suku-Suku Separuh': ¼ plate carbohydrate, ¼ protein, ½ fruit and vegetables.
tip.bm: 'Suku-Suku Separuh': ¼ pinggan karbohidrat, ¼ protein, ½ buah dan sayur.

keyPoints.en: Obesity: too much energy intake vs use → risk of heart disease, type 2 diabetes, hypertension.
keyPoints.bm: Obesiti: pengambilan tenaga melebihi penggunaan → risiko penyakit jantung, diabetes jenis 2, hipertensi.

keyPoints.en: Gastritis: stomach lining inflamed by acid (irregular meals, stress, spicy food, H. pylori).
keyPoints.bm: Gastritis: dinding perut radang akibat asid (makan tidak tetap, tekanan, makanan pedas, H. pylori).

keyPoints.en: Eating disorders: anorexia nervosa (refusing food), bulimia (binge eating then purging).
keyPoints.bm: Gangguan makan: anoreksia nervosa (enggan makan), bulimia (makan berlebihan kemudian memuntahkan).

keyPoints.en: Healthy habits: eat regularly, less sugar/salt/fat, more fibre, drink water, exercise.
keyPoints.bm: Tabiat sihat: makan berkala, kurang gula/garam/lemak, lebih serat, minum air, bersenam.

question.en: Calculate BMI for a 60 kg person who is 1.6 m tall.
question.bm: Hitung BMI bagi seseorang 60 kg dengan ketinggian 1.6 m.

tip.en: Link each habit to a disease and explain WHY it causes it.
tip.bm: Kaitkan setiap tabiat dengan penyakit dan terangkan MENGAPA ia menyebabkannya.
